The orthogonal projection of f(t) onto Span{g(t)} is given by

projg(t)f(t)=⟨f(t),g(t)⟩⟨g(t),g(t)⟩g(t).

In our case, we have

⟨f(t),g(t)⟩=∫−11(t3+10t2+2)⋅(5t2+1)dt=∫−11(5t5+50t4+t3+20t2+2)dt=[56t6+10t5+14t4+203t3+2t]−11=(56+10+14+203+2)−(56−10+14−203−2)=1123,

and

⟨g(t),g(t)⟩=∫−11(5t2+1)2dt=∫−11(25t4+10t2+1)dt=[5t5+103t3+t]−11=(5+103+1)−(−5−103−1)=563.

Therefore, the projection is

projg(t)f(t)=⟨f(t),g(t)⟩⟨g(t),g(t)⟩g(t)=(1123)(563)⋅(5t2+1)=2(5t2+1)=10t2+2.
